_note: Candidate registry for Nevada 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Nevada Secretary of State, 2026 General Election Statewide Certified List of Candidates (document title '2026 Master General Statewide Certified List of Candidates.APPROVED', posted about August 25, 2026), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Nevada Secretary of State, 2026 General Election Statewide Certified List of Candidates (document title '2026 Master General Statewide Certified List of Candidates.APPROVED', posted about August 25, 2026) (https://www.nvsos.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/20105/639232733439300000); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
